soldier: Head yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index about 0.58, the sides parallel, the posterior margin slightly rounded. The frontal ridge is slightly raised, the interfrontal area slightly concave. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the transparent region at its apex forming a short needle-like point, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs absent. The mandibles appear rather slender and straight, their apices slender and pointed and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.58 times the head capsule length and about equal to the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum falls at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal and expanding posteriorly, the middle slightly concave; the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel to each other, the waist constriction index 0.26–0.30. The pronotum is trapezoidal, 1.56 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight with a shallow notch at the middle of each, that of the anterior margin wider and deeper, with about six hairs in the middle region.
